method: Independent exact arithmetic and explicit derivation, separate from animation code
general_argument: Conditioning on truth gives E[Y]=3p/4+(1-p)/4=1/4+p/2. Linearity of expectation makes2(samplemean-1/4) unbiased. Each output likelihood ratio is at most3, giving epsilon=ln3 for one response under this mechanism.
limits: Counts are expectations, not guaranteed observations. Finite estimates fluctuate and may leave[0,1]. Repeated releases compose privacy loss; no perfect secrecy claim.
